notes: Primary source: BenQ's own specification pages (benq.com/en-us/business/projector/lk936st/specifications.html and benq.com/en-us/projector/golf/lk936st/spec.html), which agree on all port counts and types. HDMI 1 & 2 are both confirmed HDMI 2.0b/HDCP2.2 (graded hdmi-2.0). LAN RJ45 speed not explicitly stated; graded eth-100m as a conservative default typical for projector control LAN ports (not confirmed gigabit). HDBaseT RJ45 port carries video/audio/control, not left ungraded since it isn't a standard Ethernet data-rate spec. USB Type-A is 2.0/5V-2A per manual, primarily for power/service (e.g., dongle power), not a full data host — marked as output since its stated purpose is power supply rather than data transfer, though physically it could pass USB 2.0 data. S/PDIF connector form (optical Toslink vs coaxial) and AC inlet connector type (assumed IEC C13/14) were not explicitly labeled with connector hardware type on the spec sheets or accessible manual excerpts, so these two are inferred from common BenQ projector design conventions — flagged for extra scrutiny. 3D Sync In/Out and 12V Trigger are all 3.5mm mini-jacks per spec but serve non-audio signaling purposes; mapped to the closest available connector ids (trs-3.5, dc-barrel) since no dedicated "signal jack" connector id exists in the allowed list. Unit is a fixed/ceiling-mount short-throw projector (0.8 throw ratio), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Weight 7 kg, dimensions 416x166x351mm (WxHxD), power consumption 440W typical at 110V, universal AC 100-240V 50/60Hz input.
